metadata.snapshot: Historical stored account metadata, not live counts. If an ID repeats, the last stored record is used; record order is not a verified observation date.
metadata.analysed_posts: Usable posts in the fitted author document, including retweets, after the existing cleaning/deduplication rules; not all posts by that account.

retweet_directions.orientation: InfoFlow: original author -> retweeter. Sent=in-strength; received=out-strength.
retweet_directions.scope: Observed retweets within the full RetweetedOnce study network, including authors not displayed. Repeated retweets count. Not lifetime or all-Twitter totals.
